keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: Embodied robot learning with control and curricula

themes.name: Agentic LLM pipeline optimization and self-improvement

themes.name: Efficient inference with sparsity, quantization, and MoE

highlights.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
highlights.authors: Junru Hu, Cheng Tang, Wei Li et al.
highlights.theme: Agentic LLM pipeline optimization and self-improvement
highlights.why: Systematically investigates weight-space programming across benchmarks and scales, revealing that highly localized weight edits can yield large and cross-task performance gains.
highlights.key_result: WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions: on full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively, and modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. A Math-edited checkpoint also improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged.
evidence: On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement.
A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged.

highlights.title: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
highlights.theme: Topological and geometric analysis of neural representations
highlights.why: Claims a rigorous topological generalization bound and low-dimensional execution submanifold across 80+ architectures, offering a new theoretical perspective on optimization and generalization.
highlights.key_result: The paper establishes that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold with empirically observed effective dimension d_eff ≤ 12, and it introduces Top-SGD and Top-AdamW, which demonstrate a 14.1% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for.
evidence: Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension \mathbb{R}^N homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold \mathcal{M}_{exec} (with empirically observed effective dimension d_{eff} \le 12).

Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures.
Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for.

highlights.title: PINNeval: A Comprehensive Evaluation Standard for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
highlights.authors: Kevin von Bargen, Hamid Ebrahimy, Tim Romer
highlights.theme: Physics-informed neural networks and PDE operator surrogates
highlights.why: Introduces a comprehensive evaluation standard and PINNpipe package that treats four pipeline components as an integrated system, addressing reproducibility issues in PINN research.
highlights.key_result: The paper releases PINNpipe, a JAX package containing 18 different methods from the current literature as well as nine efficiently implemented benchmark problems, and its evaluations revise the claim that quasi-Newton methods are impractical for complex PDEs: a two-stage MLP pipeline (SOAP followed by SSBroyden2) attains lower median relative L^2 error and shorter runtime, with the quasi-Newton stage reducing error by up to a factor of 1.7 10^4 (Heat).
evidence: Based on this comprehensive protocol, we release PINNpipe, an innovative JAX package containing 18 different methods from the current literature as well as nine efficiently implemented benchmark problems.

The results in Figure refute this claim, as the two-stage MLP pipeline (SOAP followed by SSBroyden2) attains both a lower median relative L^2 error and a markedly shorter runtime than the single-stage PirateNet-SOAP baseline. We note that the MLP of the two-stage pipeline is the anchor MLP. In a single-axis ablation (Appendix ), float64 precision alone yields no measurable gain, and replacing PirateNet by the MLP under SOAP alone mostly increases the error. Adding the quasi-Newton stage to the same MLP at the same precision, however, reduces the error by up to a factor of 1.7 10^4 (Heat) and accounts for the accuracy gain of the two-stage pipeline.
Four case studies illustrated the protocol on the four components of the PINN training pipeline, and they revise the claim of that quasi-Newton methods are impractical for complex PDEs.

highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning with control and curricula

highlights.title: s$^3$: Simple Scaling of Swarms via Cooperative Multi-agent RL
highlights.authors: Kunal Jha, Goncalo Faria, Shuyue Stella Li et al.
highlights.theme: Safe multi-agent reinforcement learning and cooperative control
highlights.why: Introduces a cooperative MARL method where agents learn to organize themselves, achieving over 25x more coordination problem solves than static harness baselines.
highlights.key_result: With matched training and inference budgets, s^3 swarms evaluated with twice as many agents as in training solve over 25 more coordination problems than the strongest baseline, and in exploration, communicating agents reduce repeated work by nearly 50% and outperform best-of-N by up to 9.4 percentage points.
evidence: With matched training and inference budgets, s^3 swarms evaluated with twice as many agents as in training solve over 25 more coordination problems than the strongest baseline, and in exploration, communicating agents reduce repeated work by nearly 50% and outperform best-of-N by up to 9.4 percentage points.

highlights.title: Forcing a Letter Suppresses Refusal: Mechanistic Evidence from WMDP
highlights.authors: Stepan Epifantsev, Anna Antipova, Oleg Chernikov et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent security, jailbreaks, and misalignment
highlights.why: Provides mechanistic evidence that MCQ safety benchmarks suppress refusal by committing to answer letters early, showing that such scores measure knowledge rather than safety mechanisms.
highlights.key_result: The paper shows that MCQ format commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats, and that MCQ activations lie roughly 3 further from the refusal direction than their open-ended counterparts; ablating the attention heads that carry the MCQ answer increases refusal.
evidence: First, we use the tuned lens technique to show that when processing MCQ the model commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, which is in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats.
Additionally, we observe that activations on the MCQ format lie roughly 3 further from the refusal direction, compared with their open-ended counterparts.
Moreover, ablating the attention heads that carry the MCQ format answer increases the refusal, which is a direct evidence that the MCQ answer-selection competes with refusal.

highlights.title: On Lipschitz Explosion in Deep Neural Networks with Normalization: Consequences for Optimization and Adversarial Robustness
highlights.authors: Ashkan Soleymani, Reyhaneh Hosseinpourkhoshkbari, Hadi Daneshmand et al.
highlights.why: Proves that normalization can cause exponential Lipschitz explosion despite layerwise stability, undermining worst-case optimization and robustness guarantees for deep networks.
highlights.key_result: The paper shows that for deep networks with normalization layers (with batch normalization as the canonical example), both Lip_X(F_ ) and Lip_ (F;X_ in) can grow exponentially with depth m, and consequently exponentially with the ambient parameter dimension d, even under strong per-layer norm control (e.g., \|W_ \|_2 1) and already for linear activations.
evidence: We show that for deep networks with normalization layers (with batch normalization as the canonical example), both Lip_X(F_ ) and Lip_ (F;X_ in) can grow exponentially with depth m, and consequently exponentially with the ambient parameter dimension d. This occurs even under strong per-layer norm control (e.g., \|W_ \|_2 1, and in the input-Lipschitz construction even W_ orthogonal), and already for linear activations.

highlights.title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
highlights.authors: Jingdong Zhang, Jionghao Wang, Zhengming Yu et al.
highlights.theme: Agentic LLM pipeline optimization and self-improvement
highlights.why: A new benchmark for recursive self-improvement of frontier agents that tests whether agents can improve their own harness under a fixed budget, across vision and robotics tasks.
highlights.key_result: Flex-RSI is introduced as a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget: self-improvement raises the validation score in 150 of the 177 runs (85%), by a median of 10.4 points, and letting the improver edit the harness raises the test score in six of seven pairs of otherwise identical runs, by 2.0 to 40.0 points.
evidence: fig:selfimprove separates the two by comparing the starter's validation score with the best validation score reached during the run. Self-improvement raises the validation score in 150 of the 177 runs (85%), by a median of 10.4 points.

The test score with the improver is higher in six of the seven pairs, by 2.0 to 40.0 points; in the seventh, Claude Opus 5.5 on Turn On Sink Faucet reaches 80.0 in both runs, and its run without the improver reached the maximum validation score in round 8.

news.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
news.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron in which its engineers and Hacktron's security researchers select high-priority areas to test together, focused on how OpenAI systems interact with third-party services, and Hacktron receives expanded access to frontier models through Daybreak Red. The post notes that earlier in the week Cathedral's researchers were announced to join the next security sprint, and that bug bounty rewards were raised.

news.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
news.summary: NVIDIA reported that a year after open sourcing its Aerial wireless software alongside Sionna, adoption of AI Aerial and Sionna has grown 10x, its open source 5G/6G tools passed 1 million downloads, and more than 8,000 research and academic institutions use the platforms. Cited projects include a King's College London robot arm on a Jetson AGX Orin using goal-oriented semantic communications that cut task completion time by up to 52.6%, a SoftBank neural receiver integrated into Aerial CUDA-Accelerated RAN that beat a conventional receiver at all 15 tested settings with a maximum gain of roughly 60%, and ETH Zurich work that reduced block error rates by more than one-third by tuning neural receivers on local measurements.

news.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
news.summary: The tutorial describes running FLUX 3 Image Klein Base and its distilled variant in TensorRT LLM VisualGen on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, where NVFP4 delivered up to 1.62x faster text-to-image and 1.58x faster image-to-image generation than BF16 on a single B200. Combined optimizations at 2048x2048 gave up to 3.46x faster T2I and 4.45x faster I2I versus uncompiled BF16 for Base, and CFG plus Ulysses parallelism on eight B200 GPUs reduced median T2I latency from 14.90 to 3.00 seconds for Base and from 2.73 to 1.08 seconds for distilled.

news.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning Weight Refit with the Reshard Collective
news.summary: The post introduces the Reshard collective, which reformulates reinforcement learning weight refit as a DTensor-to-DTensor transfer moving only the minimum required data between arbitrary source and destination layouts, with an open source reference implementation, NCCL M2N Reshard, in the NVIDIA/nccl-extensions GitHub repo. In NeMo RL benchmarks on DGX H100 and DGX GB200 systems it achieved 2.7x to 5.7x speedup over gather-and-broadcast refit across models including Qwen 3 235B and DeepSeek v3 671B, against an estimated 10 TB payload per refit for today's largest open weight models.

news.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
news.summary: Hugging Face introduced FoundationWorlds, a framework pairing a controlled simulated world with automatic task and demonstration generation plus behavioral metrics, with ToyBlocks as the first release: an open simulation of a robot arm and blocks on a tabletop. ToyBlocks generates demonstrations without teleoperation, supports domain randomization of block size and table height, and builds on prior work including MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot, and MolmoSpaces.

news.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference added GPU partitioning using NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU, which splits a physical GPU into as many as seven hardware-isolated instances with dedicated compute and memory, letting multiple models be placed on one device. The feature works on endpoints that use inference components; single-model endpoints, serverless endpoints, and heterogeneous instance pools cannot be partitioned, and an ml.p4d.24xlarge with eight A100s is given as the example of the prior whole-GPU constraint.

news.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
news.summary: Amazon Quick's team described the taxonomy of agentic primitives it converged on, organized around four questions (When, What, Who, How): triggers (human-initiated, agent-delegated, scheduled, event-driven), agents defined as persistent learning actors composed of instructions, capabilities, and learned context, and capabilities covering tools, skills, workflows, and sub-agents. The post states the framework is mostly invisible to end users and is the first in a series covering the agentic operating system, background learning, and proactive feeds.

news.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
news.summary: A team supporting Amazon's North America Sort Center network built a serverless Model Context Protocol server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate as a central gateway between AI agents and an enterprise data lake, where adding a dataset requires only a JSON metadata file discovered on the next pipeline sync. The design targets four goals: configuration-driven access, agent-agnostic tool interfaces, centralized permission enforcement at the MCP server layer, and elastic infrastructure, split across client, MCP server, tools, and knowledge-base refresh layers.

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: Part 2 extends the Part 1 setup in which a Bedrock AgentCore task agent acts for signed-in users via Okta Cross App Access, replacing per-server wiring with AgentCore Gateway as a single front door that redeems Okta's grant for each target while the agent's role holds no token-exchange or secret permissions. Default-deny Cedar policies evaluated at the Gateway bind each tool to the agent and delegated scope, a second agent on Amazon EKS joins under its own Okta identity, and AgentCore Observability with CloudWatch plus Okta System Logs via EventBridge collects the decisions.

highlights.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
highlights.authors: Junru Hu, Cheng Tang, Wei Li et al.
highlights.theme: Agentic LLM pipeline optimization and self-improvement
highlights.why: 系统地研究了跨基准和规模的权重空间编程，揭示了高度局部化的权重编辑可以带来大幅且跨任务的性能提升。
highlights.key_result: WSP 可以通过高度局部化的干预实现显著的性能提升：在完整留出评估中，在 MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 上的准确率分别最多提高 29.45、4.42、36.72 和 17.11 个百分点，而仅修改 1,023 个参数就能带来 29.45 个百分点的提升。一个经过数学编辑的 checkpoint 还能在无需进一步编辑的情况下，将 GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 分别提高 3.03、12.18 和 20.10 个百分点，同时 SciCode 性能保持不变。
evidence: On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement.
A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged.

highlights.title: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
highlights.theme: Topological and geometric analysis of neural representations
highlights.why: 声称在 80+ 种架构上给出了严格的拓扑泛化界和低维执行子流形，为优化和泛化提供了新的理论视角。
highlights.key_result: 论文证明了十亿参数模型中的优化轨迹在动态上被限制在一个低维执行子流形上，经验观测到的有效维度 d_eff ≤ 12，并提出了 Top-SGD 和 Top-AdamW，它们在 ImageNet 上展示了总墙钟训练时间减少 14.1%，且所有计算和内存开销完全计入。
evidence: Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension \mathbb{R}^N homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold \mathcal{M}_{exec} (with empirically observed effective dimension d_{eff} \le 12).

Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures.
Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for.

highlights.title: PINNeval: A Comprehensive Evaluation Standard for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
highlights.authors: Kevin von Bargen, Hamid Ebrahimy, Tim Romer
highlights.theme: Physics-informed neural networks and PDE operator surrogates
highlights.why: 引入了一套全面的评估标准和 PINNpipe 软件包，将四个流水线组件视为一个集成系统，解决了 PINN 研究中的可复现性问题。
highlights.key_result: 本文发布了 PINNpipe，一个 JAX 软件包，包含当前文献中的 18 种不同方法以及九个高效实现的基准问题，其评估修正了拟牛顿方法对复杂 PDE 不实用的说法：一个两阶段 MLP 流水线（SOAP 后接 SSBroyden2）取得了更低的中位相对 L^2 误差和更短的运行时间，其中拟牛顿阶段将误差最多降低了 1.7 10^4 倍（Heat）。
evidence: Based on this comprehensive protocol, we release PINNpipe, an innovative JAX package containing 18 different methods from the current literature as well as nine efficiently implemented benchmark problems.

The results in Figure refute this claim, as the two-stage MLP pipeline (SOAP followed by SSBroyden2) attains both a lower median relative L^2 error and a markedly shorter runtime than the single-stage PirateNet-SOAP baseline. We note that the MLP of the two-stage pipeline is the anchor MLP. In a single-axis ablation (Appendix ), float64 precision alone yields no measurable gain, and replacing PirateNet by the MLP under SOAP alone mostly increases the error. Adding the quasi-Newton stage to the same MLP at the same precision, however, reduces the error by up to a factor of 1.7 10^4 (Heat) and accounts for the accuracy gain of the two-stage pipeline.
Four case studies illustrated the protocol on the four components of the PINN training pipeline, and they revise the claim of that quasi-Newton methods are impractical for complex PDEs.

highlights.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
highlights.authors: Meituan Robotics Team: Caicheng Wang, Chen Zhao, Chengpeng Jin et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning with control and curricula
highlights.why: 一个大规模跨具身 VLA 基础模型，拥有 147M VLM 样本和 15k 小时机器人轨迹，在真实世界桌面操作上取得了很强的结果。
highlights.key_result: Meituan-Robotics-0 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得了 93.6% 的成功率，并在 RoboDojo VLA 赛道中排名第五；在 Ethernet insertion 任务上，使用 Rollback 数据训练的 CFG-DAgger 在没有价值学习或优势标注的情况下达到了 70% 的成功率和 0.90 的进度得分。
evidence: Evaluated as a standalone policy, MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track.
On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90 without value learning or advantage labeling.

highlights.title: s$^3$: Simple Scaling of Swarms via Cooperative Multi-agent RL
highlights.authors: Kunal Jha, Goncalo Faria, Shuyue Stella Li et al.
highlights.theme: Safe multi-agent reinforcement learning and cooperative control
highlights.why: 引入了一种协作式 MARL 方法，智能体学习自我组织，相比静态 harness 基线，协调问题解决数量超过 25x。
highlights.key_result: 在训练和推理预算匹配的情况下，以训练时两倍的智能体数量评估的 s^3 群体比最强基线多解决了超过 25 个协调问题；在探索方面，通信智能体将重复工作减少了近 50%，并比 best-of-N 高出最多 9.4 个百分点。
evidence: With matched training and inference budgets, s^3 swarms evaluated with twice as many agents as in training solve over 25 more coordination problems than the strongest baseline, and in exploration, communicating agents reduce repeated work by nearly 50% and outperform best-of-N by up to 9.4 percentage points.

highlights.title: Forcing a Letter Suppresses Refusal: Mechanistic Evidence from WMDP
highlights.authors: Stepan Epifantsev, Anna Antipova, Oleg Chernikov et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent security, jailbreaks, and misalignment
highlights.why: 提供了机制性证据，表明 MCQ 安全基准通过早期锁定答案字母来抑制拒绝，说明这类分数衡量的是知识而非安全机制。
highlights.key_result: 论文表明，MCQ 格式会非常迅速地锁定答案字母 token，与开放式格式中逐渐累积的拒绝形成对比；MCQ 的激活距离拒绝方向大约比开放式对应物远 3；消融携带 MCQ 答案的注意力头会增加拒绝。
evidence: First, we use the tuned lens technique to show that when processing MCQ the model commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, which is in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats.
Additionally, we observe that activations on the MCQ format lie roughly 3 further from the refusal direction, compared with their open-ended counterparts.
Moreover, ablating the attention heads that carry the MCQ format answer increases the refusal, which is a direct evidence that the MCQ answer-selection competes with refusal.

highlights.title: On Lipschitz Explosion in Deep Neural Networks with Normalization: Consequences for Optimization and Adversarial Robustness
highlights.authors: Ashkan Soleymani, Reyhaneh Hosseinpourkhoshkbari, Hadi Daneshmand et al.
highlights.why: 证明了归一化尽管具有逐层稳定性，仍会导致 Lipschitz 指数爆炸，破坏了深度网络的最坏情况优化和鲁棒性保证。
highlights.key_result: 论文表明，对于具有归一化层的深度网络（以批量归一化为典型例子），即使在每层范数受到严格控制（例如 \|W_ \|_2 1）且对于线性激活也是如此的情况下，Lip_X(F_ ) 和 Lip_ (F;X_ in) 都可以随深度 m 指数增长，进而随环境参数维度 d 指数增长。
evidence: We show that for deep networks with normalization layers (with batch normalization as the canonical example), both Lip_X(F_ ) and Lip_ (F;X_ in) can grow exponentially with depth m, and consequently exponentially with the ambient parameter dimension d. This occurs even under strong per-layer norm control (e.g., \|W_ \|_2 1, and in the input-Lipschitz construction even W_ orthogonal), and already for linear activations.

highlights.title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
highlights.authors: Jingdong Zhang, Jionghao Wang, Zhengming Yu et al.
highlights.theme: Agentic LLM pipeline optimization and self-improvement
highlights.why: 一个新的前沿智能体递归自我改进基准，测试智能体在固定预算下能否改进自己的 harness，涵盖视觉和机器人任务。
highlights.key_result: Flex-RSI 被提出作为在固定预算下对智能体在视觉和机器人任务上进行递归自我改进的基准：自我改进在 177 次运行中的 150 次（85%）中提高了验证分数，中位提升 10.4 分；而让改进器编辑测试装置在七对原本相同的运行中的六对中提升了测试分数，提升幅度为 2.0 到 40.0 分。
evidence: fig:selfimprove separates the two by comparing the starter's validation score with the best validation score reached during the run. Self-improvement raises the validation score in 150 of the 177 runs (85%), by a median of 10.4 points.

The test score with the improver is higher in six of the seven pairs, by 2.0 to 40.0 points; in the seventh, Claude Opus 5.5 on Turn On Sink Faucet reaches 80.0 in both runs, and its run without the improver reached the maximum validation score in round 8.

news.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
news.summary: OpenAI 宣布与 Hacktron 建立合作伙伴关系，其工程师和 Hacktron 的安全研究人员将共同选择高优先级领域进行测试，重点关注 OpenAI 系统如何与第三方服务交互；Hacktron 通过 Daybreak Red 获得对前沿模型的扩展访问权限。文章指出，本周早些时候已宣布 Cathedral 的研究人员将加入下一次安全冲刺，并且漏洞赏金奖励已提高。

news.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
news.summary: NVIDIA 报道，在开源其 Aerial 无线软件及 Sionna 一年后，AI Aerial 和 Sionna 的采用量增长了 10x，其开源 5G/6G 工具下载量超过 1 million，超过 8,000 家研究和学术机构使用这些平台。被引用的项目包括：伦敦国王学院在 Jetson AGX Orin 上使用目标导向语义通信的机器人手臂，将任务完成时间最多缩短了 52.6%；SoftBank 集成到 Aerial CUDA-Accelerated RAN 的神经接收器在所有 15 个测试设置中均优于传统接收器，最大增益约为 60%；苏黎世联邦理工学院通过基于本地测量调优神经接收器，将块错误率降低了超过三分之一。

news.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
news.summary: 该教程描述了在 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 上于 TensorRT LLM VisualGen 中运行 FLUX 3 Image Klein Base 及其蒸馏版本，其中在单块 B200 上 NVFP4 的文本到图像速度比 BF16 最高快 1.62x，图像到图像速度最高快 1.58x。在 2048x2048 下进行的组合优化使 Base 的 T2I 速度比未编译的 BF16 最高快 3.46x，I2I 速度快 4.45x；在八块 B200 GPU 上使用 CFG 和 Ulysses 并行将 Base 的中位 T2I 延迟从 14.90 秒降至 3.00 秒，蒸馏版本从 2.73 秒降至 1.08 秒。

news.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning Weight Refit with the Reshard Collective
news.summary: 文章介绍了 Reshard 集合操作，它将强化学习权重重拟合重新表述为 DTensor 到 DTensor 的传输，仅在任意源布局和目标布局之间移动最少所需数据，并在 NVIDIA/nccl-extensions GitHub 仓库中提供了开源参考实现 NCCL M2N Reshard。在 DGX H100 和 DGX GB200 系统上的 NeMo RL 基准测试中，与 gather-and-broadcast 重拟合相比，在包括 Qwen 3 235B 和 DeepSeek v3 671B 在内的模型上实现了 2.7x 到 5.7x 的加速，而当今最大的开源权重模型每次重拟合的估计载荷为 10 TB。

news.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
news.summary: Hugging Face 推出了 FoundationWorlds，一个将受控模拟世界与自动任务和演示生成以及行为指标相结合的框架，首次发布的是 ToyBlocks：一个在桌面上的机器人手臂和积木的开放模拟。ToyBlocks 无需遥操作即可生成演示，支持积木尺寸和桌面高度的域随机化，并建立在包括 MolmoAct 2、MolmoBot 和 MolmoSpaces 在内的先前工作之上。

news.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference 增加了使用 NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU 的 GPU 分区功能，可将一块物理 GPU 拆分为最多七个硬件隔离的实例，每个实例具有独立的计算和内存，从而可在一台设备上放置多个模型。该功能适用于使用推理组件的端点；单模型端点、无服务器端点和异构实例池无法分区，而带有八块 A100 的 ml.p4d.24xlarge 被作为此前整块 GPU 限制的例子给出。

news.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
news.summary: Amazon Quick 团队描述了其收敛出的 agentic 原语分类法，围绕四个问题（When、What、Who、How）组织：触发器（人类发起、agent 委派、定时、事件驱动）、agent 被定义为由指令、能力和学习到的上下文组成的持续学习行动者，以及能力涵盖工具、技能、工作流和子 agent。该文称该框架对最终用户大多不可见，并且是涵盖 agentic 操作系统、后台学习和主动信息流的系列文章中的第一篇。

news.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
news.summary: 支持 Amazon 北美分拣中心网络的团队在 Amazon ECS 上使用 AWS Fargate 构建了一个无服务器 Model Context Protocol 服务器，作为 AI agent 与企业数据湖之间的中央网关；在该设计中，添加数据集仅需要一个 JSON 元数据文件，并在下一次流水线同步时被发现。该设计针对四个目标：配置驱动的访问、与 agent 无关的工具接口、在 MCP 服务器层集中执行权限，以及弹性基础设施；这些目标被拆分到客户端、MCP 服务器、工具和知识库刷新各层。

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: Part 2 扩展了 Part 1 的设置，其中 Bedrock AgentCore 任务代理通过 Okta Cross App Access 为已登录用户执行操作，用 AgentCore Gateway 作为单一前门取代了每服务器布线，Gateway 会为每个目标兑换 Okta 的授权，而代理角色不持有 token 交换或秘密权限。在 Gateway 处评估的默认拒绝 Cedar 策略将每个工具绑定到代理和委托范围，第二个代理在 Amazon EKS 上以其自己的 Okta 身份加入，AgentCore Observability 与 CloudWatch 以及通过 EventBridge 的 Okta System Logs 收集决策。
